meaning: A task listed under shipped_but_record_open has at least one non-merge commit on main whose Task: trailer names it, while its record at base is still open (status in_progress/open, or no status in .agents/tasks/). Some may legitimately have more work to come; each owner decides. Records were not edited.

limitations: tasks_without_scopes is high in full history (most older closed records never declared scopes, and `tasks close` drops the field); only local claim refs fill the gap.
Claim refs are read from this clone; another clone may have different claim refs, changing only scope findings for scope-less records.
`Task: LOCAL-<name>` commits are reported separately: labelled, but not distillable from records.
